answer.rationale: Pursue an expedited incumbent renewal/extension with market-benchmarked price and payment-term negotiations, potentially trading term or volume commitment for savings. With only 14 days remaining and the line at 94% committed volume, switching primary supply or introducing a new source this cycle creates unacceptable delivery and qualification risk. Verify the prior negotiation record before committing because achieving the mandated 18% spend reduction may require a credible benchmark and/or multi-year concession; if the incumbent cannot close the savings gap while preserving supply assurances, retain that uncertainty for the next review rather than force a risky transition now.
